name: Cardinal Capital Group
blurb: Cardinal Capital Group is a direct private lender focused primarily on New England, specializing in bridge, fix-and-flip, ground-up construction, and rental loans. The firm is known for flexible loan structuring, construction expertise, and relationship-driven lending across Massachusetts and surrounding states.

name: Rubicon Mortgage Fund, LLC
blurb: Rubicon Mortgage Fund is a California direct mortgage fund specializing in commercial real estate bridge loans and select residential investment loans. They primarily lend throughout California, with a strong focus on Northern California, emphasizing conservative leverage, in-house underwriting, and fast closings.

name: SDC Capital
blurb: SDC Capital is a Burbank-based family office lender using its own capital for residential and commercial bridge loans in major California markets, including first and second liens, cash-out, value-add and late-stage construction financing.

name: Groundfloor Lending
blurb: Groundfloor Lending provides residential investment loans in 35+ states through a hybrid institutional and crowdfunding capital model. Programs include fix-and-flip, bridge, new construction and DSCR loans, with deferred-payment options on short-term financing.

name: Center Street Lending
blurb: Center Street Lending is a direct private lender financing residential investment properties across most U.S. states. They offer bridge, fix-and-flip, and new constructio with programs for single-family and small multifamily projects.

name: Soviero Capital LLC
blurb: Family-run direct private lender based in Jupiter, Florida, providing asset-based bridge and value-add loans secured by improved residential and commercial real estate in Florida, Georgia, and Texas. Soviero typically lends up to 65% LTV and does not require a minimum credit score.

name: Sherpa Capital Group
blurb: Sherpa Capital Group is a privately owned, Chicago-based direct lender founded in 2010. It provides principal-led short-term bridge loans from $500,000 to $10 million for transitional commercial real estate nationwide and selectively makes preferred-equity investments.

name: Malve Capital LLC
blurb: Malve Capital is a New York-based private direct lender providing short-term bridge, fix-and-flip, ground-up construction, and DSCR rental loans for real estate investors nationwide. The company emphasizes asset-based underwriting, fast closings, minimal documentation, and in-house decision making.

name: Accolend
blurb: Accolend is a Paramus, New Jersey-based direct private lender providing fix-and-flip, bridge, ground-up construction, multifamily and DSCR rental loans in 40 states and Washington, D.C. It offers no-points options, in-house underwriting and loan amounts up to $8 million.

name: Gelt Financial, LLC
blurb: Gelt Financial is a direct hard money lender providing short-term bridge loans on commercial real estate and residential investment properties in 38 states. They don't have a minimum credit score and can fund unique situations like foreclosure bailouts, 1031 exchanges and more.

name: Kiavi
blurb: Kiavi is a technology-powered private lender for residential real estate investors in 32 states and Washington, D.C. They provide fix-and-flip/bridge, DSCR rental, new construction and jumbo loans, using data-driven underwriting and a largely digital closing process.

name: Rehab Wallet
blurb: Rehab Wallet, based in Lexington, South Carolina, is a private lender offering fix-and-flip, new construction, and bridge loans for investment properties across the Southeast. They cater to experienced and first-time investors alike, providing flexible terms and quick funding options without credit checks or prepayment penalties.

name: Equity Based Capital
blurb: Equity Based Capital is a privately funded direct hard money lender serving real estate investors in Connecticut only. They offer short-term bridge, fix-and-flip and cash-out refinance loans for all types of investment properites, emphasizing property equity over borrower credit.

name: Capital Funding Financial
blurb: Nationwide direct private lender providing bridge, fix-and-flip, construction, DSCR, multifamily, commercial, land, and permanent financing for real estate investors. Capital Funding Financial uses discretionary capital, offers loans from approximately $250,000, and can close qualifying bridge loans in days.

name: i Fund Cities
blurb: I Fund Cities is a privately owned real estate investment lender based in Philadelphia. They finance fix-and-flip, ground-up construction, multifamily, DSCR rental, portfolio rental, and land development projects, with local market teams and in-house construction draw management.

name: LoanEdge
blurb: LoanEdge is a California private money lender providing asset-based acquisition, refinance, cash-out, commercial bridge and multifamily bridge loans. It lends up to $8 million, uses in-house valuations, and generally does not require income documentation, financials or credit reports.

name: Certain Lending
blurb: Certain Lending is a Seattle-based private lender using a digital platform to finance residential investors nationwide, excluding several states. They offer fix-and-flip, bridge, ground-up construction, DSCR rental and rental portfolio loans for properties with up to 10 units.

name: American Heritage Lending
blurb: American Heritage Lending is a direct private and non-QM real estate lender headquartered in California. The company specializes in DSCR, bridge, fix-and-flip, construction, and other business-purpose loans nationwide through a large wholesale broker network and a smaller retail lending division.

name: Cressida Direct
blurb: Cressida Direct is a nationwide direct lender specializing in long-term financing for commercial real estate ranging from $200K to $10M, including investment leased properties, owner-user conventional and SBA loans.

name: Red Tower Capital, Inc.
blurb: Red Tower Capital is a San Francisco-based private real estate lender providing bridge, fix-and-flip, owner-occupied bridge and custom loans, primarily in Northern California. They finance residential and commercial properties using flexible, deal-focused underwriting.

name: Residential Capital Partners
blurb: Residential Capital Partners is a Dallas-based direct balance sheet lender specializing in residential investment property financing nationwide. They primarily offer high-leverage fix-and-flip, DSCR rental, and ground-up construction loans, including up to 100% financing for qualifying rehab projects.

name: FlipCo Financial
blurb: FlipCo Financial is a direct private lender serving real estate investors in selected Southeast and Midwest markets. It specializes in short-term fix-and-flip, bridge, and refinance loans for non-owner-occupied single-family and 2-4 unit properties, with no prior experience required.

name: PIM Rapid Lending
blurb: PIM Rapid Lending is a Portland-based private lender focused on short-term commercial real estate and multifamily bridge loans. They lend in 19+ states, consider secondary and tertiary markets, and may use cross-collateral or seller financing for qualifying deals.

name: Texas Equity Lending
blurb: Texas Equity Lending is a family-owned direct hard money lender based in San Antonio, financing residential, commercial, land and agricultural investment properties in major Texas markets with equity-focused underwriting.

name: Security Financial Services
blurb: Security Financial Services is a third-generation direct balance sheet lender specializing in bridge loans throughout California, with deep expertise in the San Francisco Bay Area. They primarily finance investment properties, including multifamily, mixed-use, industrial, and San Francisco TIC projects, using discretionary in-house underwriting.

name: Conventus
blurb: Conventus is a direct real estate investment lender founded in 2015, providing bridge and fix-and-flip, DSCR, multifamily and ground-up construction financing nationwide. It combines institutional capital with in-house underwriting and expedited execution.

name: Coastal Equity Group
blurb: Coastal Equity Group is a direct private lender based in Charleston, South Carolina, specializing in residential bridge, fix-and-flip, and ground-up construction loans throughout the Southeast. The firm focuses on experienced real estate investors and builders, with ground-up construction representing a significant portion of its lending activity.

name: Stormfield Capital, LLC
blurb: Stormfield Capital, LLC is a private lender based in Southport, Connecticut, specializing in fast, reliable real estate financing. Since 2015, they have funded over $2.4 billion across 2,100+ loans, offering flexible bridge loan solutions for both residential and commercial properties in the Northeast and select markets nationwide.

name: First Bridge Lending
blurb: Direct private lender and mortgage-fund platform established in 2012, providing residential business-purpose loans in California and commercial bridge loans across selected Western states. First Bridge controls underwriting and capital in-house and commonly closes qualifying loans in days.

name: New Silver
blurb: New Silver is a technology-driven private lender financing residential real estate investors across most U.S. states. They focus on fix-and-flip, ground-up construction, and DSCR rental loans, using proprietary technology for automated underwriting, instant term sheets, and proof-of-funds letters.

name: LendingOne
blurb: LendingOne is a direct private lender for non-owner-occupied residential real estate investments, offering fix-and-flip, bridge, new construction, DSCR rental, fix-to-rent and portfolio loans in most U.S. states. It serves individual, portfolio and institutional investors.

name: Crosby Capital USA
blurb: Crosby Capital is a Miami Beach-based private real estate and asset-based lender operating nationwide. They originate bridge loans from $200,000 to $50 million and also pursue note-on-note financing and non-performing loan transactions across residential and commercial real estate.

name: Myers Capital
blurb: Myers Capital is a Honolulu-based mortgage broker and direct private lender serving real estate investors in 42 states, with Hawaii as a core market. Investor programs include bridge, fix-and-flip, DSCR, construction, land, commercial and condotel financing.

name: Northern Star Mortgage Fund
blurb: Northern Star Mortgage Fund is an Irvine-based private lender established in 2016. It finances residential and commercial investment real estate across most U.S. states, offering bridge, rehab, construction, cash-out, second-mortgage and land loans, including programs for first-time investors.

name: CR Lending
blurb: CR Lending is a Prosper, Texas-based direct hard money lender offering short-term, asset-based loans for investment real estate, including bridge, fix-and-flip, rehab-to-rent and ground-up construction, with no credit check for its core programs.

name: Unitas Funding LLC
blurb: Unitas Funding is a direct private lender for U.S. real estate investors, backed by institutional capital through Fidelis Investors. It offers fix-and-flip, construction, DSCR rental and bridge financing, lending only to business entities for business-purpose transactions.

name: Pepe/Berard Capital, LLC
blurb: Pepe/Berard Capital is a boutique direct real estate lender focused on metropolitan East Coast markets. It provides bridge, fix-and-flip, refinance and construction-related financing for investment residential and commercial properties, with loan amounts generally up to $5 million.

name: Clear Sky Financial
blurb: Clear Sky Financial is a Virginia-based direct private lender specializing in residential fix-and-flip loans throughout Virginia, Maryland, and Washington, D.C. They emphasize local market expertise, flexible asset-based underwriting, fast closings, and high-leverage financing for experienced and first-time investors.

name: Private Money Funding
blurb: Private Money Funding is a Scottsdale-based private credit firm and asset-based lender focused on real-estate-backed loans. Its Arizona bridge lending commonly uses a simple 60% LTV framework for residential, commercial, land and specialty collateral, including rural properties.

name: Builders Capital
blurb: Builders Capital is a direct private lender for experienced home builders throughout the United States. It provides vertical construction financing, AD&C, build-to-rent and bridge stabilization financing structured around a builder’s pipeline rather than a single project.

name: Surf Harbour Capital
blurb: Surf Harbour Capital is a direct private credit lender serving real estate investors and developers in the Eastern United States. They offer fix-and-flip, ground-up construction, and bridge loans, with closings in 7 days, no credit checks and no appraisals in most cases.

name: First Bridge Lending CRE
blurb: First Bridge Lending CRE, based in Petaluma, California, specializes in quick bridge loans for commercial real estate across Arizona, California, Oregon, and Washington. They offer loans from $500,000 to $10 million with flexible terms and in-house underwriting, focusing on multifamily, industrial, and retail properties.

name: Matchpoint Lending
blurb: Matchpoint Lending is a direct private lender funding $1 million to $100 million first-lien business-purpose loans on Florida real estate. Based in Miami Beach, the firm specializes in South Florida luxury homes and condos but also lends on commercial properties - multifamily, retail, industrial, hotels.

name: Griffin Funding - Non-QM Home Loans
blurb: Griffin Funding, based in San Diego, California, specializes in Non-QM home loans, offering flexible mortgage solutions for self-employed individuals and real estate investors. They provide various loan products with minimum credit scores of 580 and down payments starting at 10%, covering residential properties across multiple states.

name: Rodeo Lending
blurb: Rodeo Lending is a private lender based in Los Angeles, specializing in commercial and multifamily properties. They offer flexible financing options, including short-term bridge loans and long-term DSCR loans, with a focus on practical solutions for borrowers unable to access traditional banking services.

name: Temple View Capital
blurb: Temple View Capital is a Bethesda-based national private lender for non-owner-occupied residential real estate investors. It offers DSCR rental, fix-and-flip/rehab, bridge, ground-up construction and second-mortgage rental programs, with nationwide lending and updated 2026 investor guidelines.

name: Secured Capital Lending
blurb: Secured Capital Lending is a North Hollywood-based direct private lender financing California residential and commercial investment properties. They offer bridge, fix-and-flip, construction, rehab, cash-out and second-trust-deed loans with asset-focused underwriting and fast closings.

name: Capital Fund 1, LLC
blurb: Capital Fund 1 is a direct private lender offering financing solutions to real estate investors across 8 states - fix and flip, ground-up construction, land development, multifamily bridge, CRE bridge and DSCR long-term rental loans.

name: Griffin Funding
blurb: Griffin Funding is a San Diego-based private lender specializing in DSCR rental loans for residential properties. They offer financing without tax return requirements, enabling investors to qualify based on property cash flow, with loan amounts up to $5 million and flexible terms. Their services support both long-term and short-term rentals.

name: F2 Finance LLC
blurb: F2 Finance is a direct balance sheet private lender based in Santa Monica, California, providing bridge loans for residential, mixed-use, commercial, and select land transactions across 16 states. The firm focuses on flexible, story-based underwriting, fast closings, and loans that fall outside traditional institutional credit boxes.

name: Red Rock Capital
blurb: Red Rock Capital is a Colorado-based private real estate lender and fund manager providing financing for residential investment properties with 1-4 units, including non-warrantable condos. They provide non-recourse fix-and-flip, bridge, and DSCR long-term loans to LLC's, self-directed IRAs, solo 401(k)s and foreign nationals in 40 states.

name: Versara Capital
blurb: Versara Capital is a private lender that provides hard money loans to real estate investors in 10 states. They offer quick funding with no appraisals for residential properties, accept low credit scores, and provide various loan types including bridge and rehab loans, all while focusing on asset-based lending.

name: Kayak Capital
blurb: Kayak Capital is a direct hard money lender using its own capital to fund investment property loans in Arizona and South Carolina. They finance fix-and-flips, new construction, purchases, and refinances with asset-based underwriting, up to 85% LTV, and no origination points or junk fees.

name: Casa Lending
blurb: Casa Lending is a direct private real estate lender offering fix-and-flip, bridge, portfolio, new construction and DSCR rental financing for residential investors and builders across the United States.

name: LBC Capital Income Fund, LLC
blurb: LBC Capital Income Fund is a private mortgage fund providing short-term bridge financing for residential, multifamily and commercial investment properties, with a strong California focus and select major metropolitan markets. It also considers cash-out, cross-collateral and California second-mortgage scenarios.

name: HD Lending, LLC
blurb: HD Lending is a Phoenix-based direct hard money lender serving Arizona. It finances residential, commercial, land, construction and owner-occupied properties, with first and second mortgages, conservative leverage, no stated minimum FICO, and terms extending to 30 years.

name: IceCap Group
blurb: IceCap Group is a New York-based direct private lender offering fix & flip, bridge, DSCR and ground-up construction loans in 45 states. $5B+ funded across 6,000+ loans since 2017. NPLA 2025 Private Lender of the Year.

name: Simplending Financial
blurb: Simplending Financial is a Houston-based private money lender serving real estate investors nationwide. Its programs include fix-and-flip, ground-up construction, DSCR rental, and bridge loans, with financing from $75,000 to $10 million depending on the program.

name: Paces Funding
blurb: Paces Funding is hard money lender based in Atlanta, specializing in asset-based lending for real estate investors throughout the South and Southeast. They offer a range of loan products, including bridge, rehab, and commercial loans, with quick funding and flexible terms, with no minimum credit score requirement, no bank statments or tax returns.

name: Commercial Capital BIDCO
blurb: Commercial Capital BIDCO is a Franklin, Tennessee direct lender specializing in short-term commercial real estate bridge loans nationwide except California. Its current site targets roughly $500K to $3M+ loans, including specialty-property transactions, with an internal credit committee.

name: Altaloans
blurb: Altaloans is a Florida-focused private lender for real estate investors and brokers, offering rental/DSCR, fix-and-flip, construction and bridge financing. Programs include foreign-national options, first-time investor eligibility on select products and cross-collateral structures.

name: Rehab Financial Group
blurb: Rehab Financial Group is a private balance-sheet lender financing residential investement properties in 18 states. They offer high-leverage loans up to 100% loan-to-cost for fix-and-flip and ground-up construction projects, with underwriting and servicing handled in-house.

name: Domus Lending Group
blurb: Domus Lending Group is a Florida-based direct balance sheet lender financing non-owner-occupied residential real estate. They offer ground-up construction loans across five Southeastern states and larger bridge loans in South Florida, with credit decisions made in-house.

name: Briar Cliff Financial Services
blurb: Briar Cliff Financial Services is a privately owned direct commercial mortgage lender and brokerage serving Pennsylvania, Ohio and West Virginia. The company specializes in small to medium-balance commercial, bridge, construction, and investment property loans with in-house underwriting, servicing, and appraisal capabilities.

name: Central Lending
blurb: Central Lending is a direct private lender headquartered in Lakeland, Florida, providing bridge, fix-and-flip, ground-up construction, and DSCR loans for residential real estate investors across most U.S. states. The company emphasizes fast closings, in-house underwriting, and appraisal-free bridge financing for many transactions.

name: Rain City Capital
blurb: Rain City Capital, LLC is a Kirkland-based private lender serving real estate investors across 24+ states. They offer fix-and-flip, DSCR rental, ground-up construction and bridge loans, with current programs advertising up to 95% LTC for qualifying flips and up to 90% LTC for qualifying construction.

name: Yieldi
blurb: Yieldi is a direct balance sheet lender providing short-term bridge loans for commercial real estate nationwide, including retail, industrial, self-storage, hotels, cannabis-use properties and others. They can fund ground-up construction, value-add projects or standard purchase/refinance bridge loans up to $50MM.

name: Fidelity Mortgage Lenders
blurb: Fidelity Mortgage Lenders is a California-based private mortgage lender, established in 1971, offering asset-based business-purpose financing secured by all types of investment real estate in the Western States. They lend up to 55% loan-to-value for a purchase, refinance or equity cash out.

name: Minnow Loan
blurb: Minnow Loan is a Columbia, Missouri private lender focused on fast, flexible investment-property financing. It offers fix-and-flip, bridge and commercial loans, generally from $30K to $2M for residential programs and up to $5M for commercial properties, with no prepayment penalty.

name: Ironwood Finance
blurb: Ironwood Finance is a Corpus Christi-based hard money lender with flexible guidelines for property investors throughout Texas, including small markets. They fund bridge loans, fix and flip, and ground-up construction projects from $50K to $2M. They don't check credit or bank statements.

name: ReProp Financial
blurb: ReProp Financial is a Northern California direct private lender for residential investment, commercial, agricultural and construction real estate. It serves Western U.S. markets with bridge and longer-term structures, including niche collateral such as rural and cannabis-use properties.

name: BrightBridge Realty Capital
blurb: BrightBridge Realty Capital is a New York-based direct private lender providing nationwide financing for residential real estate investors. Its programs include fix-and-flip, ground-up construction, DSCR rental, and portfolio loans, with streamlined underwriting, financing up to 90% of purchase price, and options for first-time investors.

name: RCN Capital
blurb: RCN Capital is a nationwide private direct lender established in 2010. It provides fix-and-flip, bridge, ground-up construction, DSCR rental, multifamily, and large rental-portfolio financing for real estate investors, with separate broker and correspondent channels.

name: Wilshire Quinn Capital, Inc.
blurb: Wilshire Quinn Capital is a San Diego-based direct portfolio bridge lender serving commercial and non-owner-occupied residential investors nationwide. Since 2004, it has focused on fast, in-house underwriting for purchases, refinances, cash-out, rehab and 1031-exchange transactions.

name: CB South Capital
blurb: CB South Capital is a bridge lender providing short-term financing secured by commercial real estate from $1M to $25M. They finance multifamily, mixed-use, industrial, retail, hospitality, land, and construction projects in select markets.

name: Loan Mac, Inc.
blurb: Loan Mac is a Los Angeles private lender arranging fast 1st- and 2nd-position real estate loans for business and investment purposes. It finances a broad range of property types, including land and agricultural real estate, and can structure cross-collateralized loans across the U.S.

name: Hilton Financial Corporation
blurb: Hilton Financial Corporation is a direct private/hard money lender for non-owner-occupied investment real estate in Arizona, Colorado, Hawaii, Ohio, Tennessee, Texas and Utah. It finances acquisitions, fix-and-flips, construction, renovations, bridge loans and small subdivisions, generally up to $1 million.

name: Stonecrest Financial
blurb: Stonecrest Financial is a California direct private lender based in Silicon Valley. Established in 1986, it offers consumer bridge loans, investment purchase financing, reverse 1031 exchange loans, and revolving real estate-secured lines of credit.

name: Cetan Funds, LLC
blurb: Cetan Funds is an Eugene-based private lender serving Oregon and Southwest Washington. It provides short-term, business-purpose real estate loans for fix-and-flip, rental rehab, residential and commercial bridge/construction, and land development, with loans held and serviced in-house.

name: KECO Capital, LLC
blurb: KECO Capital is a Honolulu-based private real estate lender serving investors across most U.S. states. It focuses on fix-and-flip, bridge, ground-up construction and long-term rental financing, with residential loan sizes generally from $500K to $10M.

name: Trimark Funding Inc
blurb: Trimark Funding is a Southern California private lender focused on asset-based hard money loans for real estate investors. It commonly finances fix-and-flip purchases and short-term bridge transactions without traditional credit, income, liquidity or appraisal requirements.

name: RLV Capital
blurb: RLV Capital is an Oklahoma City-based hard money real estate lender offering fix-and-flip, new construction, bridge, commercial, DSCR, lines of credit, and transactional funding in Texas and Oklahoma. They use hands-on, asset-focused underwriting.

name: Blue-inc. Capital
blurb: Blue-inc. Capital is an Oregon private real estate lender based in Eugene. It finances residential, commercial, agricultural, land, rehab and construction transactions statewide, including rural and unusual properties, with asset-focused underwriting and no formal appraisal requirement.

name: Express Capital Financing
blurb: Express Capital Financing is a direct nationwide private lender specializing in bridge, fix-and-flip, ground-up construction, DSCR, and commercial real estate loans. The company primarily serves real estate investors and developers with fast closings, flexible structures, and in-house underwriting.

name: Better Capital Fund
blurb: Better Capital Fund provides business-purpose private money loans to real estate investors across the Midwest, Southeast, Southwest and Northeast. They finance bridge and rehab loans, with amounts from $50,000 to $750,000. They do not check credit and do not require appraisals. First-time investors considered.

name: Wilshire Finance Partners
blurb: Wilshire Finance Partners is an Irvine, California real estate finance and investment company founded in 2008. It provides small-balance commercial, multifamily and seniors-housing bridge loans nationwide, generally $1M–$10M, with a focus on transitional and value-add assets.
